# The dateTime of new customer last visit is not displayed

The dateTime of new customer  last visit is not visible in BO>customers table> last visit column

![Manage your Customers • PrestaShop](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24647495/198602031-4c81ebb2-22fa-41b7-a5c7-c728b09a3977.png)

## Attendu
The dateTime of the last visit should be visible

![Manage your Customers • PrestaShop (1)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24647495/198602863-95d89cfa-88db-4c84-bf98-21b10d0baf64.png)

## Étapes
1. Go to FO > Sign in > No account? create one here
2. Create new account
3. Go to BO > Customers > Customers
4. See the error => the last visit date of the created customer is '---'

https://watch.screencastify.com/v/r2TcGRJl8kYQFTFo8kg9

Actually, I'll check `classes/Customer.php` again. The `getStats()` method is where `last_visit` is defined. If the grid uses `getStats()`, then the issue is in the SQL query.

The query:
```sql
SELECT c.`date_add` AS last_visit
FROM `ps_connections` c
LEFT JOIN `ps_guest` g USING (id_guest)
WHERE g.`id_customer` = X ORDER BY c.`date_add` DESC
```
For a brand new customer, the `ps_guest` table should have the `id_customer` updated. But maybe the `ps_connections` table doesn't have a record yet or the link is broken.

However, usually, the "last visit" in the grid is populated by the `CustomerGridDataFactoryDecorator`.

Let's read the full `src/Core/Grid/Data/Factory/CustomerGridDataFactoryDecorator.php`.
